fact: Werz hands over five unusual gems to the party as a gesture of good faith for the assassin job.
source_quote: As a gesture of good faith, Werz handed over five unusual gems
subject: Werz offers gems

fact: The five gems given by Werz are identified by Jimjar as empty spell gems.
source_quote: he identified them as empty spell gems
subject: five unusual gems

fact: The empty spell gems are of the kind used in the magical defenses of Blingdenstone.
source_quote: the very kind used in the magical defenses of Blingdenstone
subject: empty spell gems

fact: Kazook Pickshine is a gnomish alchemist in Blingdenstone.
source_quote: a gnomish alchemist named Kazook Pickshine
subject: Kazook Pickshine

fact: Kazook Pickshine would pay handsomely for the empty spell gems.
source_quote: Kazook Pickshine would pay handsomely for them
subject: Kazook Pickshine

fact: To anyone other than Kazook Pickshine, the gems are considered banal and not worth their apparent value.
source_quote: kind of banal gems
subject: empty spell gems

fact: It is unknown how Werz came into possession of the empty spell gems.
source_quote: unsettling question of how Werz had come to possess them
subject: source of gems

fact: The party returns to Ghohlbrorn's Lair to collect previously ordered magical equipment.
source_quote: the party collected the magical equipment they had previously ordered
subject: Ghohlbrorn's Lair

fact: Zalthir receives two enchanted tattoos that were ordered as magical equipment.
source_quote: two enchanted tattoos for Zalthir
subject: two enchanted tattoos

fact: Thorin acquires a +1 longsword that was ordered as magical equipment.
source_quote: a +1 longsword for Thorin
subject: +1 longsword

fact: Thorin's original order included splint armor, a +1 longsword, and darts.
source_quote: Thorin's order had been splint armor, a +1 longsword if possible, and darts
subject: Thorin's gear order

fact: The magical equipment was purchased at a 10% discount using pooled party funds.
source_quote: paid for at a 10% discount out of pooled party funds
subject: equipment purchase

fact: Jimjar heard Werz's name in Blingdenstone and believes Werz is honest about being worth trading with.
source_quote: Jimjar had heard Werz's name in Blingdenstone and thinks Werz is probably honest
subject: Jimjar

fact: Gyrgum thinks the gems might be valuable to him as a cleric depending on their usage.
source_quote: Gyrgum, as a cleric, thinks they might be valuable to him
subject: Gyrgum

fact: Rumpadump is a myconid sprout who is Stool's friend.
source_quote: Stool recognised it as his friend Rumpadump
subject: Rumpadump

fact: Zalthir recalls seeing an unhappy myconid sprout near a group of strangely dancing myconids in the caverns.
source_quote: Zalthir recalled an unhappy myconid sprout he had seen near a group of strangely dancing myconids
subject: Zalthir

fact: Stool pleads with the party to drop everything and save Rumpadump.
source_quote: pleaded with the party to drop everything and save him
subject: Stool's plea

fact: Gyrgum wants to deal with the assassins before detouring to save Rumpadump.
source_quote: Gyrgum wanted to deal with the assassins first
subject: Gyrgum

fact: The party agrees to detour to save Rumpadump because his location lies along their route to the assassins.
source_quote: since Rumpadump lay on the way, the group agreed to make the detour
subject: route decision

fact: Stool describes Prince Derendil as 'very civilized'.
source_quote: Stool contrasts the "very civilized" Prince Derendil
subject: Prince Derendil

fact: Stool claims myconids do not attack people unnecessarily but will attack back if attacked.
source_quote: Myconids don't attack people unnecessarily… But if you attack us, we attack back
subject: Stool

fact: Stool describes most quaggoths as brutish and savage.
source_quote: most quaggoths, which he calls brutish and savage
subject: Stool

fact: Stool asserts that it is in the nature of quaggoths to be violent because they are bred for it.
source_quote: It's in their nature to be violent. They are bred to be violent
subject: Stool

fact: Thorin compares Stool's view on breeding quaggoths to eugenics, noting it is wrong for sentient people.
source_quote: Thorin: "That's eugenics… But with sentient people, that's wrong."
subject: Thorin

fact: Daz compares the selective breeding of quaggoths to how orange carrots came to be.
source_quote: Daz: "It is how we ended up with orange carrots."
subject: Daz

fact: Stool states that everyone has a purpose in the circle.
source_quote: Stool: "Everyone has a purpose in the circle."
subject: Stool

fact: Stool fears that other members of his circle may be where Rumpadump is.
source_quote: He fears other members of his circle may be there too
subject: Stool

fact: Stool promises the party that Rumpadump will ensure they don't get hurt.
source_quote: Stool: "I promise you, Rumpadump will make sure we don't get hurt."
subject: Stool

fact: The party sets their next goal to get Werz removed from the assassins' list.
source_quote: the party sets its next goal: get Werz removed from the assassins' list
subject: next goal set

fact: Thorin plans to tell the assassins that radical transparency would solve the problem.
source_quote: Thorin plans to tell the assassins radical transparency would solve everything
subject: Thorin

fact: Gyrgum suggests that radical transparency means threatening to kill the assassins if they kill Werz.
source_quote: Gyrgum: "Radically transparent would probably be: you don't kill him, or we'll kill you."
subject: Gyrgum
